panel.noRoom: Set the plugin's Room / stream in its configuration so the worker knows which camera to read.
panel.empty: No plates read yet — reads appear here as the worker sees them.
panel.listHint: One plate per line (or comma-separated). Matching ignores case, spaces and dashes.
panel.blacklistHint: A plate on both lists is DENIED (blacklist wins).
panel.savedNote: Saved — the worker restarts with the new lists.
panel.eventsNote: Every read fires plate.detected through the app's signed callbacks (plus plate.allowed / plate.denied on a list match) — point your barrier webhook at them.
